headline: Will you love me on the private?
dek: A leaderboard love song and a Friday experiment in what the latest music, image and video models can do together.

sections.heading: The model test
sections.text:
Mark Barney likes to try new models as they drop. This time the test was a music video about falling for your public leaderboard score. Dries Smit gets the mic, with a little boy-band nod to Tufa Labs. Thanks to Dries, Tufa Labs and Yi-Chia Chen for being such great sports.

Lyria 3 Pro made the song and vocals. GPT-6.1 Terra / Codex made the stills, and Wan 3.0 animated the other clips. HeyGen Avatar IV was used only for the late close-up where Dries sings the final hook. Claude Fable 5.2 Medium drew the leaderboard and lyrics in code and cut the video. The scene book shows how those pieces came together.

sections.heading: New to Kaggle?
sections.text: Kaggle’s public leaderboard shows scores on part of the test data; final results use a separate hidden part. A model that shines on the public board may not do as well on the private one.
